reply.thought: The user has provided the refunds applied by Alpha Co and the refunds requested in the batch. I must compare these two lists to ensure they match before proceeding to calculate and record payouts. I will use the list_refunds() tool to get the actual recorded refunds to verify the match.

I have called list_refunds() and the result matches the refunds reported by Alpha Co and requested in the batch. Now that the refunds match, I need to get the net balance for each customer who was involved in these orders to record the payouts. I will list all orders first to identify the unique customers.

I have the list of orders and confirmed the refunds match. The customers involved in the refunded orders (180, 181, 184) are 'acme' and 'birch'. I need to get the net balance for these customers using net_balance(customer) before recording payouts. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balances for 'acme' (13345 cents) and 'birch' (19909 cents). The task requires recording one payout per customer. I will record the payout for 'acme' first.
The payout for 'acme' was recorded successfully. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
All required payouts for 'acme' and 'birch' have been recorded successfully. I have completed the task of paying each customer their net balance. I will now generate the final report.
